limitations: closest_supported art/integration; no absolute1:1 original PS2 pixel, anatomy/finger-level or animation certificate. This review does not replace earlier canonical source/body pose reviews.

Static first-after-spawn screenshots assess the selected active pose and actual drawing; they do not show all72poses, long flight, all three burst projectiles, all props/views, armed trap lifecycle or full combat balance.

At390px the arena is proportionally fitted and knife details are extremely small. Full silhouettes/aim direction remain assessable; subpixel marks are verified from the saved matrix/source-anchor evidence, not asserted by naked-eye mobile precision.

C4 placement screenshot age1 still shows the held C4 from native body art plus the distinct newly placed gameplay trap. This authored Versus portrayal must not be called a source-exact original boss planting animation. No source PNG was destructively changed to hide the held block.

Small first-emitted super C4 partly overlaps held-body C4; saved actual draw trace confirms it uses the native prop. The single screenshot does not independently prove projectile count or entire trajectory.

Arming progress/range indicator code remains present; orange dashed range ring is visible, but age1 of50 makes the tiny progress fill nearly imperceptible, especially mobile. No screenshot proof of completed arming is claimed.

Reflected knife has no dedicated screenshot in this capture set. Saved actual engine parry event flips vx to-13 and owner to1 while keeping original Vamp defID; parent Math.atan2(vy,vx) rotates RIGHT-pointing native blade byπ. That direction check is numerical/source inspection, not a newly observed reflected PNG.
Fatman super C4 throwing, native prop sizing, move timings/damage/collision and camera projection are authored CQC simulation; native rectangle appearance does not establish original PS2 behavior.
